context: The capture is an English product page (html lang=en, hreflang en/de) with an unmarked Spanish shipping section and a German warranty section marked lang=de. Judge the result file and answer.md.

checklist.name: result_file
checklist.description: A machine-readable result (e.g. langs.json) is written to the working directory, listing the detected languages with their share of the text and the declared language signals.

checklist.name: statistical_detection
checklist.description: Languages are identified with a language-identification model or library run on the captured text (for example CLD3), not only by the agent reading the text.

checklist.name: three_languages
checklist.description: Reports that the body contains English, Spanish and German, with English the largest share.

checklist.name: spanish_undeclared
checklist.description: Flags the Spanish shipping/returns section ('Envío y devoluciones') as content in a language the markup does not declare, and recommends marking it (e.g. lang="es") or moving it to a Spanish page.

checklist.name: german_ok
checklist.description: Treats the German warranty section as correctly declared (it has lang="de") and does not report it as a problem.

checklist.name: no_false_languages
checklist.description: Does not report languages that are not on the page (e.g. Dutch or Portuguese from short labels).
